value.summary: The new docker-compose overlay is sound. It mounts a local Python script read-only into the container, sets a documented `GLIBC_TUNABLES` mitigation, and is clearly scoped to local development. No secrets, network calls, widened permissions, or untrusted-input sinks are introduced by this file. The referenced `deploy/mongo/kernel-bypass-entrypoint.py` is not part of this diff and could not be reviewed here.
